label: WhatsApp Bridge (Baileys)
description: WhatsApp bridge (Baileys over WhatsApp Web) that every other WhatsApp node talks to through its `bridge` output. Pair a phone by QR code on first start; the session is kept on disk, so later starts reuse it. Its default size, a quarter CPU with 1Gi, is Compute Engine's `e2-micro` on a cloud install, about $6 a month.

outputs.name: bridge
outputs.description: The bridge's handle. Wire it into the `bridge` input of every other WhatsApp node. Baked: made when the bridge's infra is applied, so a run that reads only this output uses the saved handle and does not run this node.
